# SPD-021 — PostToolUse(Agent) completion overwrites a foreground member's run totals with final-request figures

## Brief
The Team card (SPD-010) and token accounting (SPD-013) need a member's run totals. For a foreground spawn, SubagentStop fires before PostToolUse(Agent, completed): hook_subagent_stop finds total_tokens NULL and stores the transcript sum (usage_json source transcript), then record_completion overwrites total_tokens and usage_json with the Agent tool's totalTokens and usage, which cover the final API request only. The member's cumulative tokens are lost and total_tokens means a different thing for foreground and background rows. Fix: record_completion keeps a transcript-sourced usage_json and total_tokens when present (and may still take totalDurationMs, totalToolUseCount, modelsUsed and resolvedModel), with a test for the foreground order.

Evidence: Claude Code hooks doc (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md, Agent tool telemetry table): totalTokens is 'Token count from the subagent's final API request: input, output, and cache tokens combined. This isn't a total across the whole run', and 'totalTokens and usage cover the final request only'. Event order for a foreground spawn: docs/spikes/2026-09-12-ledger-database.md, Enforcement plan, fact 8. Code: bin/spud hook_subagent_stop (transcript sum only when total_tokens is NULL) and record_completion (unconditional UPDATE of total_tokens, duration_ms, tool_uses, usage_json). tests/test_hooks.py fixture: totalTokens 41831 equals its usage object's four keys summed, for a run with at least two requests. No live row is affected yet: the only rows with usage (Pompadour, Sarpo) are background spawns, source transcript.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus, the persona tier, no children. No reviewer: its tier is fable, and Eric ruled Fable out again at the start (2026-09-13, weekly usage past half), so Spud reads the diff and reruns the suite at return. No headless probe: the evidence is the spike's event order (Enforcement plan, fact 8) and the fixture's `totalTokens`, which equals its final request's usage; any child or probe names a non-fable model. Design decided at start: `total_tokens` and the token figures the Team card reads come only from a transcript sum, and both hook orders end in the same row; the Agent tool's completion keeps its figures in `usage_json` beside the sum, never in `total_tokens`, and a completion alone leaves `total_tokens` empty (the card shows a dash, not a final-request number). The two tests that pin harness totals over the transcript are reversed. Which figure wins for duration and tool uses is the engineer's call, by what the hooks docs say those fields cover. No data repair: the four live rows with usage are all transcript sums.

## Outcome
Merged into main on 2026-09-13 at Eric's word (merge 294661c); 273 tests green on main after the merge. A member's total_tokens and the token figures on the Team card and member notes now come only from a transcript sum, whichever order SubagentStop and PostToolUse(Agent, completed) fire in. The Agent completion's final-request figures are kept in usage_json.completion, never in total_tokens, and a completion with no transcript sum leaves the Tokens cell a dash; duration_ms and tool_uses take the completion's whole-run figures when it has them. Built by [[SPUD-021/Chieftain|Chieftain]] (01, engineer, opus). The transcript sum itself counts each API request once per content block, four to five times too high: that is [[SPD-023]] (P1), which also re-sums the stored rows. The four stale lines of docs/design/2026-09-12-team-card.md go to SPD-023's writer at its merge, so the doc is edited once.
